name: dsh-phone-bridge
description: Native DSH bridge plugin: pushes sessions, events and bridge status from DSH Desktop straight to the dsh-phone node over HTTP (127.0.0.1:8460), removing the dependency on the Agents Anywhere bridge (endpoint.json + TCP JSON-RPC). Browser half sniffs the desktop's own session/event traffic and forwards it; the node ingests it via /api/bridge/ingest.
